_doc: Agenda and Next tiles (#316): emulator src/core/agenda.ts; firmware core/agenda.cpp, test_agenda. Times are epoch ms; tz = local UTC offset in minutes. config: like config/*.json. request: eventsRequest text (exact bytes). title: cutTitle (≤ 48 UTF-8 bytes). parse: a whole WebSocket result frame → parseAnswer (null = not a successful answer); the firmware streams the same text in any chunking. views: agendaLines (4 and 11 lines) and nextView of `fetch` at `now`, en and nl.

config.name: agenda-basic
config.description: An agenda tile and a next tile, each with its calendars (space-separated, 1–4). Keys kept as written.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: agenda, entities: calendar.family calendar.work, cs: 2, rs: 2}
      - {type: next, entities: calendar.family, label: Up next, cs: 2}

expect.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    title: a
    widgets:
      - {type: agenda, entities: calendar.family calendar.work, cs: 2, rs: 2}
      - {type: next, entities: calendar.family, label: Up next, cs: 2}

config.name: agenda-no-calendar
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: agenda, cs: 2, rs: 2}

expect.message: agenda: pick at least one calendar

config.name: agenda-wrong-domain
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: next, entities: calendar.family sensor.x, cs: 2}

expect.message: next: “sensor.x” is not a calendar entity

config.name: agenda-five-calendars
config.description: Rule: at most 4 calendars per tile.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: agenda, entities: calendar.a calendar.b calendar.c calendar.d calendar.e, cs: 2, rs: 2}

config.name: agenda-five-tiles
config.description: Rule: at most 4 agenda or next tiles in the config; the 5th fails on its own line.

expect.message: At most 4 agenda or next tiles
